name: Indexed Finance
fix_description: Fix the _estimatePoolValue formula in updateMinimumBalance: do not use a single token balance to estimate pool value when weights are not updated in real-time. Use TWAP or multiple token balances to prevent flash-loan manipulation of poolValue, which cascades into manipulated minimumBalance and ultimately inflated token weights via gulp.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a long, protocol-specific multi-step attack chain: nested flash swaps across multiple pairs, reindexing and minimum-balance manipulation in Indexed Finance, iterative pool swaps/mints/burns, and custom repayment handling. Writing it requires deep understanding of the pool/controller internals and Balancer-like accounting quirks, well beyond a straightforward exploit pattern.
